text: The proposed amendments to the turn prohibitions at Jane Street and Downsview Avenue are intended to address concerns with traffic infiltration in the Downsview Avenue neighbourhood. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates bus service on Jane Street, City Council approval of this report is required. On March 17, 2017, City Council approved a prohibition of northbound right-turns at the intersection of Jane Street and Downsview Avenue between the hours of 7:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday (NY20.50). This regulation was enacted to restrict entry to this neighbourhood and address the traffic infiltration concerns. Our office organized a public meeting on June 6, 2018 with area residents and businesses to discuss concerns with the effectiveness of these turn prohibitions and the need to implement other measures. The main concerns were in regards to…

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing northbound right-turn prohibition, 7:30 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday at Jane Street and Downsview Avenue. 2. City Council prohibit northbound right-turns, 6:00 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday at Jane Street and Downsview Avenue.
